name: pathforge
description: PathForge — Interactive Graph Pathfinding & Optimization Engine

scripts.build:engine: cmake -S engine -B engine/build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build engine/build
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:all: npm run build:engine && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test:all: npm run test:engine && npm run test:server && npm run test:client
